description: This file defines the ClientOutboundConnection class, which manages outbound client connections in Orleans, handling message sending, receiving, connection lifecycle, and logging.

classes.name: ClientOutboundConnection
classes.description: Manages outbound client connections, handling message transmission, connection lifecycle, and logging within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: RunInternal
methods.description: Executes the main connection loop, handling connection setup, message preamble exchange, and cleanup.

methods.name: PrepareMessageForSend
methods.description: Prepares a message for sending, assigning target silo if necessary, and handling invalid connection state.

methods.name: RetryMessage
methods.description: Retries sending a message if retry count is below maximum; otherwise, logs failure.

methods.name: SendRejection
methods.description: Sends a rejection message back to the sender with specified rejection type and reason.

methods.name: FailMessage
methods.description: Handles message failure, logs, and possibly sends rejection if message is a request.

methods.name: OnSendMessageFailure
methods.description: Handles failure to send a message, resetting target silo and re-queuing message.
